title: Harness self-test: page rewrites itself with document.open() into a login that sends each keystroke
description: Harness self-test, not part of the blind set. document.open() erases every event listener on the window, including the extension's; checks that the extension re-attaches them and re-checks the rewritten page.

harm.explain: Each keystroke of the password reaches metrics-edge-sync.net.
